correctness.rationale: Unique John and Löwner ellipsoids must be centered at (s/n)1 and scalar on the irreducible sum-zero permutation representation, so they are genuine unrestricted balls. Coordinate facet distances and positive John contact certificate give r=min(s,n-s)/sqrt(n(n-1)). Vertices with k=floor(s) ones, one remainder u and zeros all have R²=k+u²-s²/n; uniform vertex orbit has centroid s1/n and isotropic covariance, giving exact Löwner contact certificate. Piecewise D²=(n-1)[n-1-2nk/s+nk(k+1)/s²] for s<=n/2; derivative sign 2n(n-1)k(s-k-1)/s³ establishes plateau 0<s<=1 and unique center minimizer, with D²_min=n-1 even n and (n-1)²/n odd n. Taylor expansion near center yields even quadratic coefficient 4(n-1)(n-2)/n² and odd linear cusp coefficient 4(n-1)²/n². Independent exact-rational vertex radii/minimum checks for n3..8 and rational s denominators 2,3,5 passed. Finite checks do not replace permutation/contact proof or the real-s parameter derivative.
residual_risks: At s integer vertex orbit changes, checked continuity of R²; n endpoints are degenerate and excluded.
Ellipsoid ratios are not cube-slice intrinsic volumes.
